title: Dela Rosa’s counsel ‘concerned’ about SC’s Duterte writ ruling

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A legal counsel for Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on Tuesday expressed concern over the Supreme Court’s (SC) dismissal of the consolidated petitions for a writ of habeas corpus following the International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte, saying the move could be seen as a “guide” to future scenarios.
